units.title: Probability normalization
units.classification: Shared sphere-calculus support interface; definitions are not theorem credit
units.statement: Write \(E_n=\mathbb R^{n+1}\), \(S_n=\{x\in E_n:\|x\|=1\}\), and \(M_{n,N}=S_n^{\operatorname{Fin}N}\). The dimensions are natural numbers and may be zero. Write \(\tau_n=\operatorname{vol}_{E_n}.\mathrm{toSphere}\), \(\sigma_n=\tau_n(S_n)^{-1}\tau_n\), and \(\mu_{n,N}=\bigotimes_i\sigma_n\); measure scaling uses the extended nonnegative-real inverse. For every natural \(n\), the exact normalized polar measure has total mass one. The proof first establishes that the polar mass is nonzero; no denominator condition is supplied as an input.
assumptions: Use the indicated canonical real Euclidean, unit-sphere and finite-product carriers; no positive-dimension restriction is imposed.
The stated property concerns the actual defined measure; its normalization inputs are established by the proof, not supplied as assumptions.

steps.title: Cancel the finite nonzero total mass
steps.text: The polar mass is nonzero by the existing polar-measure theorem and finite by the preceding instance. Its extended-real inverse therefore cancels exactly. The proof establishes these facts before normalizing.
steps.lean:
instance sphereUniformMeasure_isProbability (n : ℕ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (sphereUniformMeasure n) where
  measure_univ := by
    rw [sphereUniformMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (sphereSurfaceMeasure_mass_ne_zero n) (measure_ne_top _ _)
